sources.title: Visa information for Sri Lankan nationals
sources.publisher: High Commission for the People's Republic of Bangladesh in Colombo
sources.officialityEvidence: The Bangladesh High Commission page is hosted on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' official mofa.gov.bd domain and declares an update of 10 August 2026. Normal TLS validation currently fails, so its passport-specific content is corroborated by the reproducible Special Branch result and official MRV workflow.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Nationals of Sri Lanka need to have Bangladesh visa endorsed on their passports before visiting Bangladesh.

sources.title: Bangladesh Online MRV Portal

sources.officialityEvidence: The Government of Bangladesh visa service is hosted on visa.gov.bd and identifies the Department of Immigration and Passports in its footer.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Take the printed form enclosed with required documents, payment of visa fees documents to the nearest Visa office / Bangladesh Mission.

sources.title: Land Permit Eligibility
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Bangladesh Police Special Branch immigration service lists SRI LANKA in its nationality selector and returns its corresponding official eligibility result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visa is required to travel to Bangladesh. Please obtain your visa from nearest Bangladeshi mission.

policies.title: Sri Lankan ordinary passports: Bangladesh advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Bangladesh's current High Commission guidance requires Sri Lankan nationals to obtain a Bangladesh visa endorsement before visiting; the official MRV service requires printed mission submission.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Sri Lankan passport holder seeking a short visitor stay in Bangladesh.
Obtain the Bangladesh visa endorsement before travel; the online MRV form must be printed and taken with supporting documents and payment to a Bangladesh visa office or mission.
The High Commission lists visitor supporting-document requirements; work, residence, transit, official or special-passport treatment and final admission are outside scope.

application.label: Bangladesh online MRV and mission submission
steps: Complete the official online MRV form.
Print the form and assemble the required documents and visa-fee payment.
Submit them to the nearest Bangladesh visa office or mission before travel.
